changelog: Fixed SIGABRT (__stack_chk_fail) in CFileLoader::SetRelatedModelInfoCB when loading 0.3.DL custom .dff models with Frame NodeName >= 24 characters
Added RW NodeName (0x0253F2FE) DFF sanitizer in custommodels.cpp to prevent both RwFrame heap overflow in NodeNameStreamRead and stack canary overflow
Hooked GetNameAndDamage on ARM32 & ARM64 to strictly clamp output to 23 chars + NUL, plus CModelInfo CStore capacity guards
